I had a very positive experience staying at Ward 14D, and I would like to sincerely appreciate the excellent care and service provided by the entire medical team. From the moment I arrived, I felt that the staff truly cared about the patients, not only in terms of medical treatment but also emotional support.
The doctors (Dr.Kitti Toochinda) were professional, knowledgeable, and always took the time to explain my condition and treatment plan clearly. They were patient when answering questions and made sure I fully understood everything, which helped me feel more confident and less anxious during my stay.
The nurses in Ward 14D were exceptional. They were kind, attentive, and always available when needed. Whether it was administering medication, checking on my condition, or simply offering words of encouragement, they consistently showed genuine compassion and dedication. Their warm attitude made a big difference in my recovery and overall comfort.
In addition, the ward was clean, well-organized, and peaceful, creating a comfortable environment for patients to rest and heal. The staff worked efficiently and professionally as a team, ensuring that everything ran smoothly throughout the day.
Overall, Ward 14D provided outstanding service with a strong focus on patient-centered care. I am truly grateful for the kindness, attention, and professionalism shown by everyone there.

On 28th January, I underwent knee surgery at Bangkok Hospital performed by Dr. Pornthep, who is an incredibly skilled, professional, and friendly doctor. The surgery went very well, and I truly appreciate his care and expertise.

The daytime nursing team was excellent — very helpful, friendly, and always smiling. Their positive attitude and willingness to assist really reflected great hospitality and made the recovery process more comfortable. Their support truly reflected the high standard of hospitality Bangkok Hospital is known for.

During the night shift, while a few nurses were helpful, the overall attentiveness was less consistent compared to the daytime team, especially for a post-surgery patient. I hope this can be improved for an even better patient experience.

Overall, Bangkok Hospital remains a highly reputable hospital, and I share this feedback constructively.

I had a very, very good experience at Bangkok Hospital Dental Department. The dentist was extremely professional, gentle, and highly skilled. All the staff were very friendly, helpful, and welcoming from the moment I arrived.

The environment is clean, modern, and very high-class. The facilities are excellent and everything feels organized and comfortable.

I truly appreciate the great care and service. Highly recommended! 🌟#dentalcenter

The staff at Ward 14D were consistently supportive, compassionate, and responsive, which made me speed recovery. Thank you!

My mother recently underwent a double knee replacement surgery performed by Dr. Phonthakorn Panichkul at Bangkok Hospital, and our family could not be more grateful for the care she received.
From the very first consultation, Dr. Phonthakorn demonstrated exceptional professionalism, skill, and reassurance. He explained the procedure, risks, and recovery expectations clearly and honestly, which gave us tremendous confidence going into such a major surgery.
What truly stood out was how closely he and his team live by the hospital’s BDMS values — Beyond Excellence, Deep Empathy, Moral Commitment, and Service with Thai Hospitality. Every interaction reflected genuine care and respect. The team was consistently polite, attentive, and supportive throughout the entire process.
As her son, I asked a lot of questions — sometimes repeatedly — and Dr. Phonthakorn was incredibly patient and thorough each time. We never felt rushed. Every concern was addressed thoughtfully and professionally.
The surgery went smoothly, and her recovery has been progressing very well. Seeing her regain mobility and independence after suffering from knee pain for years is something our family deeply appreciates.
We are sincerely thankful to Dr. Phonthakorn and the entire team at Bangkok Hospital for delivering not just excellent surgical results, but compassionate, world-class care.
Highly recommended.

I chose him at Bangkok Hospital and paid the deposit without hesitation after the consultation that day. He is an expert in various surgical techniques and incision methods, especially since I am Chinese and required a minimally invasive surgery, which required a specialist in endoscopic surgery.

Incidentally, I found Dr. Narupon's article about minimally invasive endoscopic breast augmentation surgery on the Bangkok Hospital website. After the consultation, I was very impressed. My daughter was sick, yet we had to wait over 30 minutes just to see a nurse. The waiting area was overcrowded, and you could clearly see people's frustration with the long delays. For a private hospital, this felt worse than many public ones. Very disappointing.

We visited Bangkok Hospital when my daughter was sick, expecting prompt care from a private facility. Unfortunately, the experience was very disappointing. We waited a full hour before seeing a nurse, and then spent four hours in the hospital just waiting for a doctor, which is completely unacceptable with a child in urgent need of care. The waiting area was crowded and disorganized, and the patients were clearly frustrated with the long wait. For a hospital that claims to offer world-class service, the experience was worse than many public hospitals. I absolutely do not recommend it.
